title: Reuse early Tailscale status() result in bind_tailnet_listeners
description:
Startup currently calls ts.status() twice: once for owner_id auto-detection (main.rs:44), and again inside bind_tailnet_listeners (listener.rs:46-49). The first result is computed but discarded.

Efficiency fix: Pass the early_status StatusResponse to bind_tailnet_listeners so it can reuse the result instead of making a second LocalAPI round-trip. Refactor bind_tailnet_listeners signature to accept an optional pre-fetched StatusResponse, or accept the tailscale_ips and backend_state directly.

This saves one Unix socket round-trip on every daemon startup.
